name: Checkout Clout
author: Ziga Oder

sections.description:
Turn your customers into influencer leads — automatically.

Every day, creators and influencers place orders in your store without you knowing. Checkout Clout changes that.

A subtle, optional field appears at checkout asking customers if they want to share their Instagram or TikTok handle. After the order is placed, Checkout Clout automatically looks up their follower count and scores them green, orange, or red — so you know exactly who’s worth reaching out to.

How it works

  1. Install the plugin and connect your Checkout Clout account
  2. An optional social handle field appears at checkout
  3. After each order, follower counts are retrieved and leads are scored automatically
  4. Send branded outreach emails with one click — or enable auto-send for top leads

Features

  • Checkout widget — Subtle Instagram & TikTok field embedded directly in your WooCommerce checkout
  • Automatic lead scoring — Green (10k+ followers), Orange (1k–10k), Red (<1k)
  • Outreach emails — Personalized collaboration emails sent from your dashboard. Track opens.
  • Leads dashboard — Filter, sort, and manage all creator leads in one place
  • Collaboration tracking — Track leads through outreach, negotiation, and active partnership stages
  • Customizable widget — Change colors, fonts, button text, disclaimer, and checkout position
  • Blacklist & GDPR — Delete any lead on request. Return window prevents duplicate leads.
  • WooCommerce + Shopify — Works across both platforms with the same account

Privacy & External Services

This plugin connects to checkoutclout.com to:
– Validate your API key and authenticate your account
– Store and retrieve lead data (customer handles, follower counts, email addresses)
– Send outreach emails via the Checkout Clout delivery system
– Retrieve publicly available social media follower counts via search engine APIs

Data is processed in accordance with the Checkout Clout Privacy Policy.

Submission of a social handle at checkout is entirely optional for end customers. No data is collected from customers who do not submit a handle.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0+
  • WooCommerce 7.0+
  • PHP 8.0+
  • A Checkout Clout account (free to register at checkoutclout.com)

Support

For help, visit checkoutclout.com/support or email hi@checkoutclout.com.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

Checkout Clout (checkoutclout.com)

Used to authenticate your account, store lead data (social handles, follower counts, customer emails), and send outreach emails. Data is sent after each order where a customer submits a social handle.
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy

Serper (google.serper.dev)

Used to retrieve publicly available follower counts for submitted social handles. When a customer submits a handle at checkout, the handle and platform (Instagram or TikTok) are sent to the Serper API to perform a Google search and extract the follower count from the result snippet. No customer PII (name, email, address) is sent to Serper.
– Serper Terms of Service
– Serper Privacy Policy

Stripe (stripe.com)

Used to process subscription payments for Checkout Clout plans. When a store owner upgrades their plan from the plugin’s Billing tab, they are redirected to a Stripe-hosted checkout page. Payment data is handled entirely by Stripe and is never stored by this plugin.
– Stripe Terms of Service
– Stripe Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Checkout Clout → Connect in your WordPress admin
  4. Paste your API key from your Checkout Clout dashboard
  5. Place a test order with a social handle to confirm everything works
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free to install. A Checkout Clout account is required to use the service. Plans start at $14/month for 100 lead checks. Register at checkoutclout.com.

Does this work without WooCommerce?

No — the plugin requires WooCommerce to function. For Shopify stores, use the Checkout Clout Shopify app instead.

What counts as a “check”?

Each time we retrieve a follower count after an order, that uses one credit. If a customer does not submit a social handle, no credit is used.

Is submitting a social handle mandatory for customers?

No — the widget is completely optional. Customers can skip it and complete their order normally.

How accurate is the follower count?

As long as an account is public, accuracy is 95%+. Private accounts or very new accounts may return 0 and be scored red.

Is this GDPR compliant?

Yes. Lead data is stored on behalf of the merchant and can be deleted at any time. See our Privacy Policy for details.

Where can I get support?

Visit checkoutclout.com/support or email hi@checkoutclout.com.
